title: Reference images in the image editor
summary:
Reference images reached the editor, Nanobanana got better non-square guidance, and image request pacing got less ambiguous.

The image editor added up to four reference images for Nanobanana, Seedream, and Kontext. Generated URLs include references only for supported models, and the image API accepts image URLs separated by pipes or commas.

Non-square width and height requests now send Nanobanana an aspect-ratio guide alongside any user reference images. Square requests skip the extra guide.

`geminisearch` was added as an alias for `searchgpt`, and Gemini 2.5 Flash’s Vertex model ID was corrected. Referral-link insertion probability changed from 3% to 5%.

highlights.title: Reference images in the editor
highlights.text: Add up to four reference images when generating with Nanobanana, Seedream, or Kontext. The image API also accepts reference-image URLs separated by pipes or commas. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Non-square Nanobanana images
highlights.text: Request a non-square width and height with Nanobanana; the model now receives aspect-ratio guidance alongside any reference images you provide. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
